name: traces
description: Query and troubleshoot Traces (self-hosted observability, an OpenTelemetry-based New Relic replacement) from the terminal: read errors, requests, traces and logs, run NRQL, manage dashboards, and set up OpenTelemetry instrumentation. The API token comes from the macOS Keychain or environment variables, never from a repo.

interface.shortDescription: Query errors, traces, logs and metrics in Traces
interface.longDescription: Query and troubleshoot Traces (self-hosted observability, an OpenTelemetry-based New Relic replacement) from the terminal: read errors, requests, traces and logs, run NRQL, manage dashboards, and set up OpenTelemetry instrumentation. The API token comes from the macOS Keychain or environment variables, never from a repo.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest errors in Traces.
